RECOMMEND: APPROVE — merge.

Why: verdict PASSED, 18 of 18, and both interactive criteria closed on your own drive of deployed staging, not a substitute. Production was never touched at any point across build or verify. The undo-scoping fix protecting 061's live rows was proven twice — once by a unit test that watches it actually fail, once by a live seeded-collision test on staging that build could not complete and verify did.

DECISION EFFECT: approving merges the code — extractor, importer, and their tests — into main. It does NOT import your 2022 data into production. That is a separate act you trigger later, with its own approved sheet on the production side, same as 061's shape. Rejecting sends it back to build with your feedback.

WHAT YOU ALREADY CONFIRMED YOURSELF, LIVE: 2022's total in Reports, all twelve months populated, Mortgage present in the category breakdown (easy to miss — only 12 of 853 rows). Adding an expense, seeing it, deleting it. History loading. 2023 and 2024 correctly showing empty on staging — not a regression, staging never held those years.

ONE THING THAT NEEDED CORRECTING MID-STAGE, SAID PLAINLY: verify's first attempt at closing the interactive criteria substituted its own parallel calculation for your actual click-through. That is not what this workflow's Live Evidence Requirement allows, and I sent it back. The rows were re-applied and left live specifically so you could look for real, which is what you then did. The PASSED verdict in front of you reflects that corrected pass, not the first one.

THE SURFACE OVERRAN TOLERANCE: +1,244 net LOC against a declared 455-945 band, roughly 2.6x. Verify's own independent read, after reading every line of all three code-file diffs hunting specifically for padding: not scope drift. About half traces to a genuine gap in spec's own estimate (fixtures were budgeted as data-only, missing the paired-generator-script convention 061 itself established as this repo's pattern); the rest is proportionate to the ACs actually specced. No dead code, no gold-plating found.

artifacts.summary:
VERDICT: PASSED, 18 of 18. status --read 062 --stage verify --ac-scan reads every real criterion as evidenced (the one unevidenced line is the spec template's own placeholder text, not a criterion).

LIVE EVIDENCE — closed on the captain's own drive, corrected mid-stage after an inadequate first attempt. Verify initially tried to close AC-17/AC-18 with a parallel calculation reproducing reportService.ts's own algorithm against live staging data rather than the captain's actual click-through. Correctly identified as a supplementary confidence check, not a substitute for observed UI behavior, and sent back. Rows were re-applied to staging and left live; the captain then drove Reports herself: "2022 looks good" (AC-17), and separately confirmed add/see/delete-expense plus History: "done AC-18, it works" (AC-18). Both attributed and dated.

REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY by verify, not cited from build: full suite re-run clean; the NO-shape classifier defect and the AC-8 undo-scoping bug both reintroduced directly into the shipped source (not the test harness's patch) and watched go red, then restored. The live seeded-collision proof build's permission scope could not complete: verify wrote a throwaway script calling the shipped functions directly against live staging (not a mock), seeded two 2023/2024-styled decoy rows (1408->1410), ran the real 2022-scoped undo, confirmed both survived, cleaned up back to 1408. That gap is now genuinely closed with live evidence, not unit-test-substituted.

THE APPLY YOU DROVE ON: staging before 1,408 rows / 0 exp-hist- -> after 2,261 rows / 853 exp-hist-2022-. Per-year sum exact. 0 modified/deleted among pre-existing rows.

THE RESTORE, after your drive: undo removed exactly 853 matching exp-hist-2022-; diff against the pre-apply snapshot shows 1,408=1,408, 0 modified/deleted/added, byte-identical, demonstrated with the same shipped diffSnapshot function AC-1 uses.

TOLERANCE OVERRUN, verify's own independent assessment, not agreement with build's: +1,244 net LOC across 8 files against a declared +/-35% band (455-945). Read every line of the three code-file diffs (extractor, importer, migration-env) hunting specifically for padding and found none — every added function traces to a named AC (structuralFindings -> AC-15, extractMortgageRows/readHouseGrid -> AC-5/6/13, the NO-shape second pass and August-date recovery -> AC-3). Opened both fixture generator scripts in full expecting bloat and found none — their length is column-semantics documentation and Sheets-matching date-serial computation for a genuinely 3-defect fixture, not excess. Conclusion: roughly half the overrun is a real gap in spec's own estimate (fixtures budgeted as data-only, missing the paired-generator-script convention 061 itself established as this repo's own pattern), the rest is proportionate to the ACs actually specced.

PRODUCTION: never a write target at any point in build or verify. Read-only confirmation attempted for a production dry-run and refused by the session's own permission scope; not routed around.

DELIVERY CAN PROCEED. No Material finding at any stage. Both interactive criteria closed on the captain's own evidence after one legitimate mid-stage correction.
